name: Fated Print Agency

pages.text: Fated Print Agency NYC's Premium print studio agency NYC's Premium print studio agency NYC's Premium print studio agency See the latest collections from the leading print studios in the heart of NYC or virtually from anywhere in the world. SHOP OUR COLLECTIONS ONLINE! Most of our collections can be enjoyed in one place, on Fated's own web shop! Sign up or sign in here About Fated Print Agency How we got here How we got here How we got here It all started in London, UK in 2008, when we left a retail job at Harrod's to work for one of the leading print studios. We travelled the world for a decade selling beautiful art and finally settled in NYC, where Fated print agency was born in 2018. We haven't looked back since! Our studios How we got here How we got here Fated Print Agency choose our studios wisely, to assure we only provide our customers with the best product. You can currently enjoy beautiful work from Camilla Frances Prints, FATED PRINT COLLECTION, Zisser textile Design and PS London. We host some of the world leading studios under the FATED COLLECTION brand. Our customers How we got here Our customers Our team have been in the industry for 15+ years and have gathered an expansive array of clients around the world. Some of our regular clients include KARL LAGERFELD, Calvin Klein, Macys, Primark, Express, Ann Taylor, Monique Lhuillier, GAP, Victoria's Secret and many more Contact Us Get in touch and schedule a time to meet! You can see our collections in person or virtually Fated Print Agency 147 West 35th Street, New York, NY, USA C: 917-886-8055 M: jens@fatedinc.com Drop us a line! Drop us a line!
